plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the official 2026-2027 American Baptist College catalog, 'DEGREE AUDIT SHEET for BIBLE & THEOLOGY MAJORS', the variant printed on catalog pp. 73-75 (Year One Fall through Year Four Spring; 40 courses x 3 credits = 120 credits). The catalog prints a second variant of this sheet on pp. 76-77 (Year Two Fall shows HIS 2010 instead of DAT 1020; Year Three Fall shows 'BST or THG for Elective in Major' instead of the required PST 3080 Field Education); the pp. 73-75 variant is used because it matches the printed degree-requirements block (DAT 1020 in the core; PST 3080 in the required major core) and the 2025-2026 sheet. Two obvious sheet typos corrected and documented: 'GS 1010 - Natural Science' transcribed as GSC 1010 (the general-science prefix used across the catalog), and 'HI 2010 African American History' transcribed as HIS 2010 (the catalog's history prefix). 'PST 3080 Field Ed' expanded to 'Field Education' per the requirements block ('PST 3080 Field Education'). Elective structure per the requirements block: at least 4 courses (12 hours) of electives from BST/THG ('BST or THG for Elective in Major' slots) and up to 4 courses (12 hours) from other degree programs ('Elective from any major' slots). Concentration/minor (18 hours / 6 courses) chosen by the sophomore year; the Year Two Spring 'Required introductory course Concentration/Minor' slot is the concentration/minor's required introductory course. The catalog's course-description header states 'Prerequisite to all Bible Courses is BST 1010'; the audit-sheet sequence places BST 1010 (Year One, Spring) before all other Bible courses, so it is documented here rather than repeated as a machine prereq. All ABC courses are 3 credit hours; total_credits equals the sum of ALL semester course credits including choice slots. transfer_confidence is 'core_only': ABC is a private four-year college with no published TCCNS/articulation equivalencies for these courses, so tccns mirrors the local course code.

courses.choice_note: Catalog wording: 'Concentration/Minor course'. Choose a concentration or minor by the sophomore year (18 hours / 6 courses): Pastoral Concentration — PST 1010 Introduction to the Practice of Christian Ministry & Cultural Competence (required) plus five PST courses chosen in conversation with the advisor (may include CMU 2020 Black Church Music and/or CMU 2010 Music Ministry & Leadership); Bible & Homiletics — 6 courses from BST and THG courses at the 2000, 3000, and 4000 levels chosen in conversation with the advisor; Church Administration — PST 1010 (required) plus five of PST 3040 Pastoral Ministry, Finance, & Administration, PST 3053 Family Ministries in the Church, PST 4030 Faith & Public Policy, LST 1020 Developing the Healthy Leader, LST 2020 Enhancing Leadership for Technology, LST 2040 Leadership Principles for Business & Ministry, LST 4010 Business Law, LST 4030 Strategic Planning & Decisionmaking, MAT 3010 Business Finance, MGT 2000 Foundations of Management, MKT 3000 Principles of Marketing; Black Church Studies — HIS 3010 The Black Church (required) plus five of CMU 2020 Black Church Music, CMU 2010 Music Ministry & Leadership, ENG 3030 Black Religious Writings, PST 3010 Homiletics I, PST 3020 Homiletics II, THG 4030 Black Womanist, & Liberation Theology, THG 4040 Liberation Theology of James Cone, SOC 3030 Marriage & the Black Family, PSY 3010 Psychology of the Black Female, PSY 3020 Psychology of the Black Male, PRS 4010 African American Religious Experience; Community and Nonprofit Organization — CHS 1010 Introduction to Social Justice (required) plus five of CHS 3010 History of the Church & Social Welfare, PRS 4040 Religion, Poverty, & Justice, PRS 4050 Voices from the Movement - Then & Now, SOC 2010 Foundations of Peacemaking, SOC 3010 Conflict Management & Crisis Intervention, SOC 3020 Sexual Violence in Church & Society, SOC 3030 Marriage & the Black Family, SOC 3040 Gender Roles in Church & Society, SOC 4020 SEAL.ed Strategies for Civic Transformation, PSY 4010 Theories of Personality, DAT 1010 Introduction to Data Science; Human Services Minor — BEH 1020 Introduction to Counseling, BEH 2010 Human Services, BEH 2040 Foundations of Addictions, BEH 3010 Intervention & Prevention, SOC 3010 Conflict Management & Crisis Prevention, HMS 1030 Introduction to Social Work, HMS 3010 Human Services Administration, HMS 3020 Human Services Administration II (prereq HMS 3010), HMS 3030 Individual & Family Assessments; Data Analytics Minor — STAT 1010 Statistics for Data Science, DAT 2010 Introduction to Excel, DAT 2030 Introduction to Programming with Python, DAT 3010 Visualization: Telling Stories with Data (Power BI), DAT 3020 Ethics for Data Science, DAT 4010 Applied Capstone.
